scope: Offline research integration of existing HMAC/context/receipt/measurement/replay checks with a fixed integer error-budget selector; no native historical record is signed and no real source trust is established
input: Immutable JSON wire strings/bytes in candidate and anchor roles. Parse into private snapshots before verification. Roles, distinct declared domains, uncertainty and calibration interval are provisioned by trusted receiver configuration, never read from self-asserted trust fields in a message.
authorization: Exactly one candidate and one anchor policy, matching provisioned guard source/channel rules. Each source/key must already pass the existing guard. Swapped roles are rejected before consuming that source's sequence. Bad candidate authentication may fall back only to a separately authenticated eligible anchor.
anchor_eligibility: Explicit research_assumption=true; measurement and receiver now both within inclusive configured calibration interval; uncertainty integer0..500mm/s. Configuration is an illustrative simulation premise, not an origin, calibration, independence or attestation certificate.
selector: normal context: if candidate and anchor authenticate and abs(candidate_mmps-anchor_mmps)+anchor_uncertainty_mmps<=500, output candidate; otherwise eligible anchor. elevated context: eligible anchor only. lockdown: abstain without authenticating/consuming incoming reports. Unknown risk or unsupported operation denies.
units: New signed envelopes use integer mm/s. The500mm/s budget equals the existing0.5m/s gate. The declared uncertainty must cover source and representation errors; this component supplies no measured calibration. Existing historical CAN values and earlier experiment decisions are not quantized or changed.
context: Existing guard binds vehicle/session/capture and authorized channel; trusted receiver supplies immutable wire, receipt/now times and normal/elevated/lockdown risk state. There is no risk classifier or external context-attestation service here.
state: Existing guard commits each authenticated report independently. Authentication consumes sequence even if later policy abstains; invalid messages do not. No cache, multi-source transaction or automatic state reset. The older local-database snapshot rollback limitation remains.
failure_controls: Compromised anchor/signing key can authenticate a false value and defeat the conditional research selector; duplicate keys or declared domains cannot constitute independent sources; no inference from valid MAC to sensor truth.
physical_action: Only operation=research_speed is supported; all physical/vehicle operations are unavailable in this adapter. physical_speed_authorized,measurement_truth_established,physical_witness_enabled and promotion_allowed are always false, independent of configuration.
existing_gates: Prior P95<=0.5m/s, coverage>=95%, accepted proxy disagreement>2m/s count0,100msage and1m/slegacy agreement remain unchanged. No improved full-cohort outcomes are claimed for this new wire-format component.
candidate_interval: An authenticated candidate must also be within its configured source-policy interval to be used in normal context; otherwise use eligible anchor. Authentication sequence has already committed.
